lesson.robot_mechanical_observation.summ: Observe a crouched service robot as connected mechanical forms, refine near/far limb proportions, and add restrained panel texture that follows the body.
lesson.robot_mechanical_observation.step: Observe the head, torso and hip block as three forms turning in the same three-quarter view.
lesson.robot_mechanical_observation.help: Compare the visible left and right edges instead of making every face equally wide.
lesson.robot_mechanical_observation.comp: The core masses now share a believable mechanical viewpoint.
lesson.robot_mechanical_observation.step: Build the near arm as shoulder, upper arm, elbow and forearm rather than one continuous tube.
lesson.robot_mechanical_observation.help: Let each part overlap the next. The elbow should visibly interrupt the arm contour.
lesson.robot_mechanical_observation.comp: The near arm now reads as connected mechanical parts.
lesson.robot_mechanical_observation.step: Add a smaller far arm and keep some of it hidden behind the torso.
lesson.robot_mechanical_observation.help: Reduce both width and exposure on the far side so it recedes naturally.
lesson.robot_mechanical_observation.comp: The arm size difference creates clear depth.
lesson.robot_mechanical_observation.step: Angle the two support legs into a crouch and use different foot shapes to anchor the pose.
lesson.robot_mechanical_observation.help: Think about weight: the feet spread away from the center while the hips stay lower than a standing robot.
lesson.robot_mechanical_observation.comp: The robot now has a stable crouched service pose.
lesson.robot_mechanical_observation.step: Add a few seams, vents and panel lines that follow the forms instead of filling every surface.
lesson.robot_mechanical_observation.help: Use texture to describe direction and connection. Stop before the details overpower the silhouette.
lesson.robot_mechanical_observation.comp: The restrained mechanical texture completes the observational robot study.
